description: Guo Jia, slender young chinese strategist in the supplied pixel art style. Long black hair with a topknot tied by yellow ribbons, a blue robe with gold trim and wide white sleeves, dark shoes. He holds a bundle of bamboo slips in front of his chest
face: A pale refined face, no beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: long black hair with the yellow ribbons, the blue robe with gold trim, white sleeves at both sides. What he holds is in front of the body and hidden.
guard_action: the right hand lifts what it holds up beside the right shoulder, the left hand lowers, the left foot settles half a step forward

actions.idle: Calm ready stance holding the bundle of bamboo slips up, breathing
actions.move: Brisk walk in place with small steps, robe swaying, bundle of bamboo slips held up, seamless loop. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Upward flick. Frames 3-6 the knees bend and the bundle of bamboo slips is lowered in front; frames 7-8 the body straightens up tall and it is flicked from below to high above the head; frames 9-11 hold high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bundle of bamboo slips stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: Open-palm push. The bundle of bamboo slips stays at his right side. Frames 3-6 the empty LEFT hand draws back; frames 7-8 the left shoulder turns forward, body side-on, and the open left palm pushes straight out; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bundle of bamboo slips stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Wide sweeping release. Frames 3-6 the bundle of bamboo slips is wound to the left chest; frame 7 the left foot steps out; frame 8 it is swept wide to the right; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bundle of bamboo slips stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s4: Pointing out the target. Frames 3-6 the bundle of bamboo slips is held to the chest; frames 7-8 the body turns side-on, a deep step, and the arm extends fully, pointing it at one spot; frames 9-12 hold; the left hand goes behind the back. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bundle of bamboo slips stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: Downward stroke. Frames 3-6 he stands tall and raises the  above the head; frames 7-8 he drops into a deep knee bend and draws it straight down in front; frames 9-11 hold low.
